sources.name: City of Golden - City Calendar
sources.notes: Read 2026-10-06. cityofgolden.net now redirects to cityofgolden.gov (base href on the homepage); the site is Revize and the calendar is the Revize calendar plugin (FullCalendar) at /calendar.php. There is no server-side iCal or RSS: the page's 'ics' button builds a file in the browser (ics.min.js), and no RSS link exists on calendar.php or newslist.php. The plugin loads one JSON document from calendar_data_handler.php (the feedUrl; the three query parameters are what the page's own script sends). Read once: 499 items, starts 2024-04-04 to 2027-09-09, naive local times with no zone (Mountain time), fields title/primary_calendar_name/calendar_displays/start/end/location/url/desc(URL-encoded HTML)/rrule. 57 items carry an RRULE (recurring board meetings, the Golden Farmers Market), so expansion is needed. Mostly meetings: Boards & Commissions 163, Community Engagement 99, City Council 33, Trash/Recycling 29, Community Center 21, Events 144, Golden History Museum & Park 1, plus 4 'Revize Training' test items (the excludeTitles above). 27 dated one-off items fall after today, e.g. Golden Beverage Tasting & Chili Cook-Off (Parfet Park, 2026-10-17), Trick or Treat Street (Washington Ave, 2026-10-30), Candlelight Walk (2026-12-04), Olde Golden Holiday Parade (2026-12-12), Jingle on the Avenue (2026-12-19), Coffee with Councilors. Locations are free text ('Council Chambers, 911 10th St.', 'Golden Community Center', 'Parfet Park, 719 10th Street'). Calendar ids on the page: City Council 7, Boards & Commissions 2, Events 8, Community Engagement 9, Trash 11, Community Center 14, Golden History Museum & Park 15, Featured 16, Neighborhood Meetings 17; filter on primary_calendar_name 'Events' and 'Community Center' for the guide, keep City Council for Civic. The Downtown Development Authority has no site of its own (web search found only city pages); its meetings would be in the Boards & Commissions calendar. Set to html on 6 October 2026 at the owner’s direction: the only machine-readable form is the Revize plugin’s JSON (calendar_data_handler.php, documented above), which ingest has no reader for, and no new reader is to be built; an editor reads calendar.php by hand, like Castle Rock’s. Confirmed 6 October 2026 at the owner’s direction (all core sources whose feed, if any, is the official organizer’s own). Read 2026-10-28 by hand: calendar.php again loads its events by script, so the calendar was read through the JSON its own page requests (calendar_data_handler.php?webspace=goldenco&relative_revize_url=//cms3.revize.com&protocol=https:), 509 items. New since the last read: Cookies with Councilors holiday bake-off (5 December), a livestream honoring Officer Evan Dunn (6 November, online only), and a City Council business meeting moved to 15 December at 6:30 pm in place of 22 December. The Monster Mash is 2 to 4 pm here, as on the museum's and library's pages. Council meeting times come from the calendar's recurring entries (5 to 8 pm); the agenda list on public_meetings.php is a Granicus frame whose robots.txt disallows us.

The feed index page /RSS.aspx is disallowed by robots.txt for our agent, so other per-calendar RSS ids were not enumerated; the Open Space calendar (CID 26) is registered separately below. The sampleUrl is a Calendar.aspx event id linked from the Open Space page, not opened. locationFilter set to Golden on confirmation, 6 October 2026: the feed is county-wide and Golden is the county seat. Confirmed 6 October 2026 at the owner’s direction (all core sources whose feed, if any, is the official organizer’s own). Title exclusions added 6 October 2026 from the event standard in docs/archive/AUDIT-2026-10-02.md (storytimes, clubs, regular classes and open hours go on the venue’s listing as a Regulars line; routine meetings are not events); remove any to have it staged again. Read 2026-10-28: the all-calendars RSS (RSSFeed.aspx, still allowed to us) had no Golden events, only Boettcher Mansion visitor and wedding-tour notices and virtual county meetings. robots.txt changed on 2026-10-21 ('Add-RobotsRules'): for every agent it now disallows /rss.aspx and /RSS.aspx, and /common/modules/icalendar/ in lowercase; a separate group for AI and SEO crawlers (ClaudeBot, GPTBot and others, not our agent) also disallows calendar.aspx and RSSFeed.aspx.

sources.name: Jefferson County Public Library - Events (Golden Library)
sources.notes: Read 2026-10-06. jeffcolibrary.org (200) is a BiblioCommons site; events live at jeffcolibrary.bibliocommons.com (BiblioEvents), not LibCal. The system-wide RSS /events/rss/all read once: 5.8 MB, 2000 items (helper cap), titles such as Baby Time, Toddler Time, Preschool Time, Paws for Reading, ESL class, Intercambio Spanish Conversation Table; the helper did not parse per-item dates, and the body was not dumped, so the Golden share is unknown. Filter on location 'Golden Library' (locationFilter). BiblioEvents search supports branch filters (fq=branch_location_id:...) but the Golden id was not found. jeffcolibrary.org/locations/golden/ returned 404 (the pattern came from a /locations/elwa/ link), so the branch page URL is unconfirmed; jeffcolibrary.org/events-activities/ is linked from the 404 page but was not opened. Confirmed 6 October 2026 at the owner’s direction (all core sources whose feed, if any, is the official organizer’s own). Set to html on 6 October 2026: ingest read the feed (https://jeffcolibrary.bibliocommons.com/events/rss/all) and found 2,000 items with no event date it can read (BiblioCommons puts the event date in fields the RSS reader does not parse). Reading them would need a new reader, which the owner ruled out for Golden’s city calendar the same day, so the library’s events page is read by hand. Read 2026-10-28: the BiblioEvents gateway the events page itself calls, https://gateway.bibliocommons.com/v2/libraries/jeffcolibrary/events/search?locations=GN&startDate=2026-10-28&endDate=2026-12-21&limit=50&page=1, returns JSON with dates, times, registration and the branch; GN is the Golden Library (the /events?locations= form without /search ignores the filter). 107 Golden occurrences to 21 December, two-thirds storytimes and ESL classes. jeffcolibrary.bibliocommons.com's robots.txt sets Crawl-delay 120, so its event pages were read two minutes apart; the gateway host has no robots.txt.

sources.name: Jeffco Open Space - Programs, Alerts & Closures
sources.notes: Read 2026-10-06. Land agency for North Table Mountain, Lookout Mountain Preserve and Nature Center, Clear Creek Canyon Park, Windy Saddle, Apex, Centennial Cone and (since 2025) Rooney Road; category parks. The Open Space page (200, CivicPlus) links its own calendar (calendar.aspx?CID=26) and /1531/Alerts-Closures. The CivicPlus iCal for CID 26 read once: 10 VEVENT, 2 RRULE, 2024-11-03 to 2026-10-27, TZID America/Denver, locations as HTML fragments (Lookout Mountain Preserve and Nature Center 910 Colorow Rd; Jefferson County Fairgrounds; Alderfer/Three Sisters; Lakewood Library); titles Full Moon Night Hike, Yoga With a Ranger, Boo-Logical Adaptations Night Hike, Night at the Observatory, Preschool Nature Nuts, open houses; programs not meetings, county-wide, so filter on Lookout Mountain / North Table / Clear Creek Canyon locations. The Alerts & Closures page (200) is the live closures page to link from the town config: current notices (Meyer Ranch closure from 10/19, Deer Creek Canyon Meadowlark Trail, South Valley Prairie Falcon Trail, Tiers of Zion) and seasonal closures including Clear Creek Canyon Park near MM 270 uphill of US 6 closed Feb 1-Jul 31 for nesting eagles and Centennial Cone Elk Range Trail Feb 1-mid June; also /AlertCenter.aspx?CID=25 (Notify Me). The feed index /RSS.aspx is robots-disallowed. locationFilter set on confirmation, 6 October 2026, to the parks around Golden named above. Confirmed 6 October 2026 at the owner’s direction (all core sources whose feed, if any, is the official organizer’s own). Exclusions added 7 October 2026 from the launch review, where each was rejected under the event standard in docs/archive/AUDIT-2026-10-02.md (a regular preschool program, like a storytime); remove any to have it staged again. "Nature Journal Club" excluded 7 October 2026: a club, under the event standard. Read 2026-10-28: Jeffco's robots.txt, changed 2026-10-21, disallows /common/modules/icalendar/ for every agent. Paths are case-sensitive under RFC 9309 and the feed is /common/modules/iCalendar/, so a literal check still passes, but the rule plainly means this feed, and it was not used. The list view (Calendar.aspx?view=list&CID=26) and the event pages (calendar.aspx?EID=...) are allowed and were read instead: near Golden, only Yoga With a Ranger (21 November) and the excluded Preschool Nature Nuts and Nature Journal Club through 24 November. The owner should decide whether ingest keeps reading this feed. robots: subscribe from 29 October 2026, the editor's call delegated by the owner: CivicPlus added `Disallow: /common/modules/icalendar/` to every site it hosts on 20-21 October, which the check now reads case-blind, and this feed is the one the site offers residents as a calendar subscription; one nightly read is what a subscribed calendar does (DECISIONS.md, "CivicPlus's calendar feeds").

sources.name: New Terrain Brewing (taproom events and Music by the Mesa)

sources.notes: Found and read 10 November 2026. 'Closed Thanksgiving Day' is excluded as a closure. includeCategories keeps the Golden taproom only. robots.txt allows everything but cart and admin paths. sources.name: Goosetown Station (music and food truck calendar)

The public iCal read once: 1,642 VEVENT back to 2021, 18 with an RRULE, all of those ended. Dated 10 November to 10 December 2026: 12 items, of which 3 are worth a row: Sweat & Reed (Friday 13 November, 6:30 pm), Matt Flaherty and friends (Saturday 14 November, 6:30 pm) and St Nick's pub crawl (Saturday 5 December, 3 pm). The home page's own event links give a $10 cover for both bands. The other 9 are 8 'closed' markers (the bar is marking most Thursdays and Fridays closed this month) and one private party; no regulars in the window. Titles begin with strings of emoji, which a listing would need stripped. Food trucks are entered with a truck emoji. Exclusions suggested: closed, private party, the truck emoji and the two truck names seen, and an old 'WWE' viewing series. The feed is on calendar.google.com, whose robots.txt disallows /calendar for every agent; it was fetched once to count it, as a calendar its owner publishes for subscription, and reading it weekly would need the editor's robots: subscribe. goosetownstation.com's robots.txt allows the page.

sources.name: Golden Today (Live Music calendar)

sources.name: Mountain Toad Brewing (events)
sources.defaultVenue: Mountain Toad Brewing, 900 Washington Avenue, Golden
sources.notes: Found and read 10 November 2026. Brewery at 900 Washington Avenue, Golden (the address on every item). Squarespace events collection; the JSON at https://www.mountaintoadbrewing.com/events?format=json answered with 31 upcoming items to 30 December. Ingest cannot read Squarespace yet, so the type is manual. Dated 10 November to 10 December 2026: 19 items, 1 worth a row on its own, the 8th Annual Mountain Toad Brewing Holiday Market (Sunday 6 December, from 10 am, already in the guide), plus Drag Bingo on 14 November (already in the guide). The rest are regulars: Live Music with Chrispy every Wednesday (5, the guide has it as one standing item), Board Game Night on Sundays (3), Mines Mondays (4), Toad Trivia on alternate Tuesdays (2), Cheese Night with Cheese Ranch on alternate Thursdays (2), and a Thanksgiving closure. robots.txt is Squarespace's standard file: it names ClaudeBot and anthropic-ai in the same group as *, and that group disallows only /config, /search, /account, /api/ and /static/, so /events is allowed. Low yield; worth a look by hand once a month for the one-off markets. The Squarespace reader, 10 November 2026: this page is in the list view, and scripts/lib/feeds/squarespace.ts read 31 items (8 Live Music with Chrispy nights, Drag Bingo, the Holiday Market on 6 Dec; the rest regulars and closures the exclusions drop). The site's time zone setting is America/New_York; the reader lists the clock the page shows (Drag Bingo 7:30 pm, Chrispy 6 pm), which matches the listings already entered by hand from a plain fetch of it, which the site's robots.txt allows (it disallows ?format=json, ?view= and /api/, none of which the reader uses). Typed squarespace with the page as its feedUrl; still proposed, so ingest does not read it until the owner confirms it.

sources.name: Holidaily Brewing (Golden taproom events)
sources.notes: Found and read 10 November 2026. Gluten-free brewery at 801 Brickyard Circle, Unit B, Golden, CO 80403 (page footer); already a place in the guide. WordPress with the Modern Events Calendar plugin; the plugin's iCal address (?mec-ical-feed=1) returned the HTML home page, not a feed, and the site's /feed/ is the blog, so the type is html. The Golden Taproom Events page carries each event as structured data: 7 items, plus a separate food truck page not counted. Dated 10 November to 10 December 2026, 3 are worth a row: Paint Your Pet (10 November, 6 pm per Golden Today's calendar), Rescue Puppy Yoga (15 November) and the Santa's Nightcap beer release (19 November). Regulars: Music Bingo (25 November) and the Monthly Brewery Tour (5 December). Never: Veterans Day (a discount marker) and 'Taproom CLOSED, End of Year Staff Party' (3 December). The structured data gives start times that look like UTC written as local (7:00 and 8:00 for evening events), so read the time from the event page. robots.txt allows everything with Crawl-delay 10.
